mapper.select: SELECT pmc.id AS methodId, cc.code AS methodCode, pmc.name AS methodName, ma.url AS imageUrl, pmc.description AS description, pmc.active AS active, pmc.sort_no AS sortNo FROM pay_method_cfg pmc JOIN common_code cc ON pmc.method_id = cc.id JOIN media_asset ma ON pmc.image_asset_id = ma.id ORDER BY pmc.sort_no ASC, pmc.id ASC
SELECT cc.id FROM common_code cc JOIN code_group cg ON cg.id = cc.code_grp_id WHERE cg.group_code = 'PAYMENT_STATUS' AND cc.code = #{statusCode}

SELECT pmc.id AS methodId, cc.code AS methodCode, pmc.name AS methodName, ma.url AS imageUrl, pmc.description AS description, pmc.active AS active, pmc.sort_no AS sortNo FROM pay_method_cfg pmc JOIN common_code cc ON pmc.method_id = cc.id JOIN media_asset ma ON pmc.image_asset_id = ma.id WHERE cc.code = #{methodCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay_method_cfg WHERE id = #{methodId}
